target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82)
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier kernels; binary-archive splice of our own hand-assembled AGX programs (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/assembled bytes
task_origin: Dispatch: settle H1 (r64-95 ALU-source addressing mechanism or proven restriction), H2 (is byte0=0x2b/reg_move_c9 the real GPR move), H3 (reg_move src_reg addressing rule vs kernel buffer signature); plus falu2 ctrl bits4-6 and the iminmax splice anomaly. Builds on EXP-0092/EXP-0099/EXP-0101/EXP-0105/EXP-0087.

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_*_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,group,carrier,oracle,expect_match,notes,dispatch,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture

confirm_vs_refute.H1_ALIAS_RECONFIRM: CONFIRMS the aliasing model if observed==30.0 (r3's value); would REFUTE it (and be a genuine positive for r67 addressing) if observed==0.0 (r67 unwritten, genuinely read) or any other distinct value
confirm_vs_refute.H1_CTRL_BITS_4_6: per bit: CONFIRMS a bank-select mechanism if reg=67 changes away from its baseline while reg=3 stays at 30.0; REFUTES it (inert) if reg=67 stays at its aliased 30.0; identifies a general corruptor if reg=3 ALSO changes
confirm_vs_refute.H1_LOADFWD: singlehop cases: pre-registered per-R prediction from the pilot phase, re-tested independently under this gate. persist/mismatch cases: CONFIRMS persistent register semantics if the second/independent read ALSO matches; REFUTES it (ephemeral forwarding only) if the second read reads 0 while the first still matches
confirm_vs_refute.H2_REGMOVE_C9: producer-independence cases: REFUTES 'real GPR move' if v1/v2 (different producer values, same src_reg) read IDENTICAL raw content (checked post-hoc in analysis.py); pair cases: CONFIRMS EXP-0101's pair-quantization pattern extends to this family if src_reg X and X^1 read identical content
confirm_vs_refute.H3_BUFFER_SIGNATURE: CONFIRMS a buffer-count-dependent addressing rule if content at a fixed src_reg SHIFTS across the buf1/buf2/buf3 carriers; REFUTES it if content is identical across all three

oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain and EXP-0090/EXP-0099/EXP-0101/EXP-0105's own HW-validated falu2/falu2i/device_store/reg_move field conventions, plus this experiment's own pilot-phase field extraction (PROGRESS.md) for the H1_LOADFWD/H2 groups
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE + PUBLIC. Every byte executed is either produced by isadb.assemble() from named fields, or is an untouched byte range of our own compiled carrier kernel. EXP-0087/0092/0099/0101/0105's own RESULTS.md content is cited as prior, already-committed repository evidence, never re-derived from any Apple binary. No Apple binary introspected.
